{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democratic socialists fight for a world in which all people participate democratically in the governing of the economic, political and cultural institutions and relationships that shape their lives.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"In the near term, democratic socialists struggle for reforms that shift power and resources away from corporate elites and put them in the hands of ordinary people.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The mission of the Democratic Socialists of America (DSA) is to participate in establishing democratic socialism as a political force in the United States and the world.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA aims to establish democratic socialism by training and mobilizing socialist activists.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA aims to establish democratic socialism by educating the public about the democratic socialist values of equality, liberty and solidarity.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA aims to establish democratic socialism by helping to build progressive coalitions to win victories that move the United States towards greater democracy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
